tasks.instruction: Zadania wlasne w formacie etapu szkolnego (nie z arkusza olimpiady). Wykorzystujac slowa podane wielkimi literami, uzupelnij luki w zdaniach tak, aby zachowac sens zdania wyjsciowego. W kazda luke mozesz wpisac do 6 wyrazow lacznie z wyrazem podanym. Nie wolno zmieniac form podanych slow. Niedopuszczalne sa formy skrocone (isn't, won't, would've itd.). Wymagana jest pelna poprawnosc gramatyczna i ortograficzna.

items.original: I haven't been to the cinema for ages.
items.transformed: It _________ I went to the cinema.
items.answer: has been ages since / is ages since
only he had studied / only he had worked

items.original: It took me two hours to finish the report.
items.answer: spent two hours finishing / spent two hours on / spent two hours writing

items.original: They cancelled the match because of the snow.
items.transformed: The match _________ because of the snow.

items.original: It isn't worth repairing this old radio.
items.answer: is no point repairing / is no point in repairing

items.original: Ewa was late because she missed the bus.
items.transformed: Ewa would have arrived on time _________ the bus.

Everyone was surprised that she won the race.
